name: Passport Number Validation Fails Then Succeeds
goal: User enters an invalid passport number first, then corrects it on the second attempt.
constraints: First passport number fails validation, second is valid. Max attempts not exceeded.

phases.description: Agent initializes, user selects 'Manchester' as embassy city.
Bot asks for passport name, user provides 'Oliver Smith'.
Bot asks for passport number, user provides 'ABC123', validation returns 'NA'.
User provides valid start date, confirms.
User provides valid end date, confirms.
Bot triggers invitation letter workflow and confirms.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
